intro: On the bank of the Alara stream, in Antalya province, stands Alara Han, a caravanserai from 1232. It was the first stop on the road inland from the port of Alanya, and together with the rock castle above, it guarded that road.
history: The han was built in 1232 for Alâeddin Keykubad I. It was the first stage on the road from the port of Alanya to Konya, watched over by Alara Castle on the crag above, raised in the same years. Notice its plan: it is closed, with no courtyard, and every part sits under one roof.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the closed plan and the portal. Find the bath block, and look up to Alara Castle.
facts: Did you know? The han included a bath for travellers. Only a minority of Seljuk caravanserais had one, and the reason is simple: Alara was the first night on the road. Alara Castle, built in the same years on the crag above, watched over that road.
outro: This brings our tour of Alara Han to an end. Before you go, a small request: please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Travellers have rested here for centuries; let these stones wait for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
